scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsx --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply calocount --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply calocount --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: pnpm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run
